findings.evidence: app/server.py:77-79: _read_json_body() requires Content-Length header to parse JSON payload.
findings.recommendation: For standard REST API usage Content-Length is standard; if supporting arbitrary chunked transfer encoding in HTTP/1.1 in future iterations, consider supporting chunked reader fallback.

findings.evidence: web/app.js:323: window.confirm() is used to confirm task deletion.
findings.recommendation: While functional and lightweight, replacing the browser's native window.confirm dialog with an in-DOM accessible modal dialog would match the styling of the custom notification banner.

findings.evidence: app/database.py:16-18: get_connection() initializes SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled in default journal mode.
findings.recommendation: Enabling SQLite Write-Ahead Logging (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;) can further improve concurrent read/write concurrency across multiple worker threads.

final_audit.summary: Comprehensive audit of the MiniBoard codebase against docs/SPECIFICATION.md completed. The implementation strictly adheres to all architectural principles and product requirements: zero third-party dependencies (strictly standard library and vanilla web technologies), fully compliant SQLite persistence and schema integrity with CHECK constraints, robust REST API contracts with accurate status codes and JSON error formatting, complete static asset serving with directory traversal guards, responsive Kanban frontend with inline editing and drag-and-drop interactions, and exhaustive test coverage across test_api.py, test_persistence.py, and the 12-step standalone smoke_test.py.
